title: Topic 22 政治
japanese_text:
A：公務員が無免許運転で捕まったんだって。
B：知ってる。７年も運転してたらしいよ。本当にあきれた話だよな。
A：７年も！<u>相当</u>ひどいね。
english_translation:
A: I heard that a government employee was arrested for driving without a license.
B: I know. I heard he's been driving like that for seven years. It's scandalous.
A: Seven years! That's really quite bad.
